research.name: Kibo UI
research.note: shadcn/ui registry of larger composable components such as Gantt, Kanban, contribution graph and image crop.

effects: Gantt chart with resizable timeline items, date markers and a today marker
drag-and-drop Kanban board with status columns
GitHub-style contribution graph with legend and tooltips
